summary: Phase 3 Red tests committed and run at HEAD fe5a22c2. All three target suites fail for the intended reasons: the shared `packages/domain/src/games/` module is absent, the standalone complete route still trusts client `xp`/`accuracy`/invalid game types, and the representative `HauntedLibraryGame` component still emits the old `onComplete` payload with `xp` and without `idempotencyKey`. blocking_findings: Missing shared contract: `packages/domain/src/games/{schema,xp,mutations}.js` do not exist, causing `packages/domain/src/__tests__/games.test.ts` to fail at module resolution (`Cannot find module '/src/games/schema.js'`).

Five of seven rewritten route tests fail.

Representative game gap: `HauntedLibraryGame.tsx#onComplete` still sends `{xp, accuracy, correctAnswers, totalAttempts}` and omits `gameType`, `idempotencyKey`, `duration`, `victory`, `score`, `difficulty`, and `clientTimestamp`. Two of twelve component tests fail.
